TOWNSHIP OF EXAMPLE
PLANNING BOARD
REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
September 12, 2024

The regular meeting of the Planning Board of the Township of Example was called to order at 7:30 p.m. by Chairman Robert Vance.

ROLL CALL
Present: Chairman Vance, Vice Chairwoman Lopez, Mr. Greene, Ms. Patel, Mayor Donnelly, Mr. Russo (Alt. I)
Absent: Mr. Chen
Also present: Board Attorney Karen M. Whitfield, Esq.; Board Engineer Thomas J. Albright, P.E., C.M.E., of Albright & Keller Engineering, LLC; Board Planner Susan Hale, P.P., AICP; Board Secretary Linda Morrow.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES
Motion by Mr. Greene, seconded by Ms. Patel, to approve the minutes of August 8, 2024. All in favor.

PUBLIC HEARINGS

1. Application No. PB-24-07 – Maple Street Holdings, LLC – Block 412, Lot 3.01 – 118 Maple Street – C-2 Zone
Preliminary and Final Major Site Plan with bulk variances for a 2-story mixed-use building.
Michael D. Torres, Esq., of Torres & Blum, LLP, appeared on behalf of the applicant.
James R. Kowalski, P.E., P.P., of Kowalski Engineering Associates, Inc. was sworn and accepted as an expert in civil engineering and planning. Mr. Kowalski described the site, the proposed 24 parking spaces, and the stormwater management system including a subsurface infiltration basin.
Mr. Albright, the Board Engineer, stated that the drainage calculations must be revised to reflect the NJDEP 2023 stormwater rule and that the applicant should provide a maintenance plan for the infiltration system. Mr. Albright noted that the lighting plan exceeds 0.5 foot-candles at the residential property line.
The applicant requested a waiver from checklist item 14 (Environmental Impact Statement) and checklist item 22 (Traffic Impact Study). Ms. Hale recommended that the waiver for the Environmental Impact Statement be granted given the previously disturbed site. The Board Engineer did not support the waiver for the Traffic Impact Study; the applicant will be required to submit a traffic study prior to the next hearing.
Anthony Petrillo, P.P., AICP, of Petrillo Planning Group, LLC, was sworn and testified regarding the c(2) variances for front yard setback and lot coverage. Mr. Petrillo opined that the benefits outweigh the detriments.
Laura Bennett, AIA, of Bennett Architects, PA, was sworn and presented the architectural elevations.
Ms. Hale, the Board Planner, requested that the applicant revise the landscaping plan to add street trees along Maple Street and provide a trash enclosure detail.
The hearing was opened to the public. No members of the public came forward.
The application was carried to October 10, 2024 with no further notice required.

2. Application No. PB-24-09 – Harbor Logistics, Inc. – Block 7, Lots 12 & 13 – 400 Industrial Way – I-1 Zone
Minor Site Plan for a 6,000 sq. ft. warehouse addition.
Dana Feld, Esq., appeared on behalf of the applicant. Peter Nowak, P.E., of Nowak Civil Engineering, LLC, was sworn and testified regarding the site plan, grading and the truck circulation.
The applicant requested a waiver from the requirement to submit a landscape plan prepared by a licensed landscape architect. The waiver was granted.
The applicant also requested a design waiver from the 50-foot buffer requirement. The Board denied the design waiver and the applicant agreed to provide the full buffer with evergreen plantings.
Mr. Albright noted that the soil erosion and sediment control plan must be certified by the Somerset-Union Soil Conservation District prior to the issuance of permits, and that an outside agency approval from the Township MUA is required for the sanitary sewer connection.
Motion by Ms. Lopez, seconded by Mr. Russo, to approve the application with conditions. Ayes: 6. Nays: 0. The application was approved with conditions.

RESOLUTIONS
3. Resolution memorializing the approval of Application PB-24-05, Riverside Gardens, LLC, Block 90, Lot 1, Preliminary Major Subdivision. Motion by Mr. Greene, seconded by Ms. Patel. Approved by those eligible to vote.

ADJOURNMENT
Motion to adjourn at 10:05 p.m. All in favor.
Respectfully submitted, Linda Morrow, Board Secretary
